landmarks.name: Pulgas Water Temple

sources.temple geometry: https://github.com/boxwrench/water_temple (lod/Pulgas-Water-Temple-lod86k-s90.blend, the maintainer's Blender reconstruction, converted by pipeline/structure_mesh.py)

landmarks.note: Temple centre from NAIP (2 m from Wikipedia's coordinates); its model is scaled at 13.2 m per model unit, the landing's terracotta ring (model radius 0.3635) measuring 4.8 m in radius on NAIP; radius is its lowest step (model 0.5). Pool: the turquoise area on NAIP, 38 by 13 m, its long axis (axis: east and north components) through the temple, its centre 38.1 m along it. Cypress: rows about 2 m outside the pool's long sides, 3.3 m apart (the crowns' period on NAIP); heights, crown radius and the 3 m bare trunk are illustrative, from photographs. Canal: traced on NAIP from behind the temple to its mouth, about 5 m across its walls; where the bundle's shoreline lies beyond the mouth the renderer carries it on to the water. Forecourt, plaza and lavender beds: illustrative, from photographs and the paved area on NAIP. Ground elevation: 3DEP at the temple centre.
